packages.name: deep-license-demo
packages.description: Demonstration project showcasing deep licenses in open source components.

packages.name: logback-classic
packages.licenseComments: The package declares dual licensing under EPL-1.0 and LGPL-2.1. However, deep license analysis of the source files reveals embedded code and notices carrying Apache-2.0 and MIT licenses within bundled utilities and compatibility shims. These are the 'deep licenses' not visible from the top-level POM declaration alone.
packages.summary: Logback Classic module — a native SLF4J implementation.
packages.description: Logback is intended as a successor to the popular log4j project, picking up where log4j 1.x leaves off. This component has deep licenses: while the declared license is EPL-1.0 OR LGPL-2.1, scanning the actual JAR reveals Apache-2.0 and MIT licensed code embedded inside.
attributionTexts: This package contains code originally from the Apache Software Foundation, licensed under Apache-2.0.
Portions of this package include MIT-licensed utility code from the SLF4J project.

packages.name: logback-core
packages.licenseComments: Transitive dependency of logback-classic. Declared as EPL-1.0 / LGPL-2.1 dual-license, but deep scan reveals Apache-2.0 licensed code in bundled servlet and utility classes.
packages.description: Core module of the Logback logging framework. Contains foundational classes reused by logback-classic. Deep license analysis shows Apache-2.0 code embedded in internal utility packages.

packages.name: slf4j-api
packages.description: The Simple Logging Facade for Java (SLF4J) API. Transitive dependency of logback-classic.

files.comment: Primary Logger class. Header declares EPL-1.0 / LGPL-2.1 — matches the top-level declared license.
